title: Lahore Police Target One-Wheeling Biker Gangs
excerpt: Traffic police in Lahore have initiated a crackdown against individuals engaging in dangerous one-wheeling on local roads.
body_html:
Traffic authorities in Lahore have initiated a major crackdown targeting individuals involved in dangerous one-wheeling on public roads.

According to the reports, the action was launched to address groups of riders performing stunts that create fear and safety risks for other citizens using the roads.
